title: Desk Reference: Referral Visit Counts and Prior Authorization Extension Units
content:
The units a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension adds carry a referral addition that follows the largest number of visits on any referral the member's primary care provider has issued, as recorded on the member's Primary Care Provider Assignment.

| Largest visit count on any referral issued | Units added |
|---|---|
| 20 visits or more | 2 |
| 10 to 19 visits | 1 |
| fewer than 10 visits | 0 |
| no referral issued | 0 |

Every referral the primary care provider has issued is looked at, whatever its date; only the single largest visit count decides the addition. The addition is made once to the units the extension adds, before the floor of zero and the ceiling of the class's extension allotment are applied.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Referrals for 8 visits and for 20 visits: the largest is 20, so 2 units are added.
- One referral for 19 visits: 1 unit is added.
- One referral for 10 visits: 1 unit is added; a referral for 9 visits adds nothing.
